description: qou-5vhf step 2 (bean qou-0fxk): the order-zero part of any Markov-trace cross term tr(w) − tr(w′) is 2^{c(w)−n} − 2^{c(w′)−n} (the trace at q = 1 is the component-count trace; verified on all of S₃, S₄ in the spin-½ rep), so a cross term has positive q-adic order iff the two closures have the same number of components. Component-changing pairs (the n = 4 trefoil-vs-chain word, order 0, ~0.9 nats at the proton pin) carry a classical cross term; component-preserving pairs — the corpus's Brunnian band word w₃ = [A₀₁,A₁₂] against the 3-unlink — carry a pure q-deformation cross term: 1 − τ_Borr = h⁴(3+h²)/(h²+4), order 4, ~1.4e-3 at the pin. Route B's 'all orders in q' object is exactly the Brunnian class. Magnitudes through E₀ = m_e/(q₀(q₀−1)) are recorded as a diagnostic against the quoted μ₃ = 0.4708 MeV target; nothing is fitted or wired. Scope (a).

data.verdict: Component count decides the q-adic order: order 0 iff the closures' component counts differ. The corpus's Brunnian 3-body operator is the component-preserving, order-4 class — the one place route B's 'all orders in q' reading applies — and its magnitude at the pin is ~h⁴ ≈ 1.4e-3 (E₀·deficit ≈ 6e-3 MeV), two orders below the quoted μ₃ target, while a component-changing (classical) cross term is ~0.9 nats (≈ 3.7 MeV), an order above it. The missing 3-body magnitude sits between the two classes; neither class supplies it as it stands. Diagnostic only; not a fit.

caveats: μ₃ = 0.4708 MeV is QUOTED from BorromeanThreeBodyCluster.lean's docstring, not derived here.
Scope (a): 3- and 4-strand word classes; the general 'iff' is elementary (2^k injective).
